notes.title: New Update for Parking Tycoon: Key Bindings, Autosave, Drones, and More!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,  

A fresh update for Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator is here, packed with exciting features, improvements, and fixes to keep your parking empire thriving. Here’s what’s included in this update:  

🎮 Key Bindings  
You can now customize your controls for a more personalized gameplay experience.  

🔧 Improved Construction Zones 
- Fixed construction zones after sidewalk upgrades.  
- Highlighted zones make planning and building much clearer.  

💾 Autosave Feature 
Never lose your progress again! Autosave is now live, keeping your game secure as you expand your parking empire.  

📯 Less Frequent Horns 
We’ve toned down the constant honking - your ears will thank us!  

💡 New Lighting Models  
Several new lighting options have been added to enhance your parking lot’s atmosphere.  

🧠 Smarter AI  
The intelligence of workers, vandals, and vehicles has been slightly improved, making their actions more realistic and engaging.  

🤖 Drone Variety  
Introducing three new types of drones to add variety and utility to your operations.  

This update reflects your feedback and our commitment to creating the ultimate parking simulation experience. We’re excited for you to try out these changes and see how they enhance your management strategy.  

Thank you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator. Jump back into the game today and take your parking business to new heights!  

Best regards,  
The Parking Tycoon Team

notes.title: Attention, Parking Tycoon Enthusiasts! “Basement” Update is Live! Dive in Now!
notes.content:
Dear Parking Tycoons,

Great news! The latest update for "Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator" has been released and is now available for you to explore. This update brings a focused and significant addition – the Basement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370808/e915ea99c4897d98ddc80d680551a03968a1aec5.png[/img]

Introducing the Basement:
With this update, we introduce the Basement, a new layer of gameplay that enhances your strategic options. Delve into the underground world and expand your parking empire with an impressive 72 new parking spots. This extension not only boosts your car capacity but also presents new strategic opportunities for managing and optimizing your parking space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370808/0c47ee174e0e107cf0a21bd744dd7acd6c61a2d8.png[/img]

What the Basement Offers:

Fresh Parking Territory: The Basement introduces a new, underground environment for your parking lot, providing a unique space to explore and develop.
Strategic Depth: The Basement, featuring 72 new spots, challenges you to rethink your space management and revenue maximization strategies.
A New Challenge: Managing an underground space comes with its own set of considerations – choose wisely to maximize efficiency and profit.
This update is dedicated to enhancing your gameplay experience with the introduction of the Basement, without any distractions. Our focus has been on ensuring that this new feature seamlessly integrates into the existing game, giving you more avenues to expand and succeed in your parking lot business.

Get ready to explore the depths underground as you strive to become the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon. We can't wait to see how you leverage this new space!

Thank you for your continued passion and support for "Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator."

Warm regards,
The Midnight Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 25, 2023
notes.content:
Hello, Tycoons!

We're rolling out a new update to make your parking empire even more dynamic and responsive. Here are the details of the improvements and new features you'll find after you patch the game:

[olist]
[*] UI Enhancements: We've ironed out the kinks in the user interface for a smoother management experience.
[*] Vandal Mechanics: Look out for vandals with improved behavior and animations - your guard will now intercept them more effectively.
[*] Cleaner Worker AI: Our diligent cleaners have been retrained to keep your lots spick and span with added polish.
[*] NPC Life: NPCs come to life with new animations, adding more vibrancy to your lots.
[*] Sound Fixes: We've tuned out the car horn bug, no more endless beeping.
[*] Speedy Barriers: Cars now pass through automatic barriers at a quicker pace, reducing congestion.
[*] Achievement Unlocked: We've added a host of achievements for you to discover and earn.
[*] General Tweaks: Along with the major changes, we've made numerous small tweaks to improve gameplay.
[/olist]


[h2]Coming Soon: The Basement Level[/h2]

Many of you have asked, and we've listened. Our next significant update will introduce the highly anticipated basement parking level. Get ready to expand downwards with a whole new level to manage. Stay tuned for more details and sneak peeks in the coming weeks. For now, here's a glimpse of what's to come with some exclusive screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370808/22028728dd9eaed4d910f3eba8ed2516fd16cf24.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370808/41b8cade33b01e31fab063a62b6d079e988b3cac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44370808/e6ec9ca3b97a4c96374b5b0b8728f2bbbe05fffe.jpg[/img]


We're committed to making "Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator" the best it can be, and your feedback is a big part of that. Keep it coming, and happy parking!

Keep expanding,
The Midnight Games Team

notes.title: Enhanced AI & Gameplay!
notes.content:
[b]Elevate Your Tycoon Experience![/b]
Greetings, Entrepreneurs!

We're excited to roll out an update that's packed with improvements aimed at perfecting your gameplay in "Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator." Here's what's new in your tycoon world:

[b]Enhanced Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[b]Traffic AI Overhaul:[/b] We've upgraded the traffic system for smoother vehicle flow and fewer collisions. It’s not perfect, but it's a leap forward in traffic management.
[b]Upgraded Employee Logic:[/b] Our employee bots are now sharper than ever, ensuring your parking empire runs more efficiently.
[b]Refined Interaction:[/b] Interacting with objects like trash and parking spaces is now more intuitive. Cleaning up and maintaining your lots is a breeze!
[b]Fortified Fences:[/b] Keep your property safe with our new, virtually indestructible Level 3 fences.
[b]Pause and Plan:[/b] Need a breather? Now you can pause the game to strategize your next big business move.
[b]Spot Damaged Cars Instantly:[/b] A new outline feature highlights vehicles in need of attention, helping you manage your lots even better.
[b]Added Chinese language[/b]
[/list]

Plus, we've made several minor adjustments to ensure a smoother and more stable gaming experience.

Your input drives our updates, and we're committed to continually evolving the game to meet your expectations. Keep the feedback coming, and let's build the best parking empire the virtual world has ever seen!

Keep expanding,

notes.title: Update Live: Second Floor & More Fixes!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We're thrilled to roll out the latest update for Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator, now live and waiting for you! This patch not only squashes the second-floor bug but also brings a host of improvements to enhance your gameplay.

[b]Here's the rundown of the fixes and improvements:[/b]
- Second Floor Bug: We've fixed the issue with cars falling through the second floor.
- Vending Machine Crowds: Reduced the number of people at vending machines for better flow.
- Night Visibility: We've brightened the night, so you can see more clearly after dark.
- Traffic Improvements: Enhanced car traffic logic to decrease collisions.

This update is a direct response to your valuable feedback. We're always listening and working to make your experience better.

[b]To ensure a smooth transition:[/b]
Please download the update immediately.
After updating, any issues with the second floor should be resolved.
Check out the vending machines, night-time visuals, and traffic flow - and let us know what you think!
Your support makes continuous improvements possible. If you notice any other issues, please continue to send your feedback.

Enjoy the improved Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator, and thank you for being an essential part of our community.

notes.title: Second Floor Bug Fixed - [UPDATE: IT'S LIVE]
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're excited to announce that the bug affecting the second floor of our parking facility has been squashed! Our team has worked diligently to address the issue that some of you encountered, where cars would fall through the map, making it impossible to profit from the second level.

We have submitted the update containing the fix to Steam and are currently waiting for their approval. Once approved, the update will be automatically applied to your game, and normal operation of your parking empire can resume.

We understand the inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience and support as we worked through the problem. Our community's gameplay experience is our top priority, and we're committed to ensuring that "Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator" is as enjoyable and bug-free as possible.

Stay tuned for the update to go live, and get ready to take full advantage of your parking facility's second floor!
